Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:1:1.hebrew: ומדכליו של מוכר ברשות לוקח לא קנה כו' - וא"ת, מנא ליה דמתורת רשותו קנה? דלמא מתורת משיכה קנה, דהא משיכה מועלת בכליו של מוכר כדמפרש לעיל. וי"ל דהכא דייק דמתורת רשותו קנה, כדפירש לעיל בקונטרס, דפירקן והכניסן לתוך ביתו — משמע בין מוכר בין לוקח. וא"ת, בלא פירקן נמי, כיון שהכניסן ליקני, דליבטיל אגב רשות לוקח? ואור"י דדוקא כלי הוא דבטיל אגב הרשות, אבל בהמה לא:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:1:1.english: "And from [the ruling about] the seller's vessels in the buyer's domain, he did not acquire," etc. - And if you ask: How does he know that [the buyer] acquired by virtue of his domain? Perhaps he acquired by virtue of pulling (meshikhah), for pulling is effective with the seller's vessels, as [the Gemara] explains above. And one can answer: Here he infers that [the buyer] acquired by virtue of his domain, as [Rashi] explained above in the Kuntres, that [the Mishnah says] "he unloaded them and brought them into his house" — which implies [that it applies to] either seller or buyer. And if you ask: Even without unloading, once he brought them in, let him acquire, since there should be nullification by way of the buyer's domain. And the Ri answers: Only a vessel is nullified by way of the domain, but an animal is not.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:5:1.hebrew: אבל דברים שדרכן בהגבהה אין נקנים אלא בהגבהה - והא דפריך במי שמת (לקמן בבא בתרא דף קנא.) גבי מלוגא דשטרי: "והא לא משך", ודוחק לומר שהיה כל כך הרבה שטרות שלא היה דרכן להגביה. אלא לאו דוקא נקט "משך", אלא כלומר: "והא לא הגביה":
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:5:1.english: But items that are typically acquired by lifting are acquired only through lifting - And as for the Gemara's question in [the chapter] "Mi She'met" (below, Bava Batra 151a) regarding the bundle of promissory notes: "But he did not pull it!" — it is difficult to say that there were so many promissory notes that it was not customary to lift them. Rather, [the Gemara] did not mean "pulled" precisely, but rather it means: "But he did not lift it."

Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:8:1.hebrew: והא כיס דבר הגבהה הוא כו' - לא פריך להאי לישנא דמשני בריש אלו נערות (כתובות דף לא:): כשצירף ידו למטה מג' וקבלה, דלא קנה מטעם משיכה אלא מטעם חצר, וידו כחצרו; אלא לההוא לישנא דהתם דקני משום משיכה פריך. וא"ת, והיכי ס"ד דמיירי בכיס? דבר הגבהה הוא! א"כ היכי מיחייב לענין שבת? הא אין דרך הוצאה בכך, כדדייק בריש אלו נערות (שם): אי בזוטרי — אין דרך הוצאה בכך, אלא במיצעי. ויש לומר, דיש דברים שדרך הוצאה בכך לענין שבת, ואפי' הכי לענין קנין אין נקנין אלא בהגבהה, שדרכן להגביה. אי נמי, במגרר דרך מחתרת, דהוי דרך הוצאה. אי נמי, הוה ליה למימר "וליטעמיך":
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:8:1.english: "But a purse is an item [acquired by] lifting, etc." - [The Gemara] does not raise this question according to that version, which the Gemara answers at the beginning of "Eilu Na'arot" (Ketubot 31b): [that the case is] where he joined his hand [to the object] lower than three [handbreadths] and received it, so that he did not acquire it by way of pulling, but by way of [the principle of] a courtyard, as his hand is like his courtyard. Rather, it asks [this question] only according to that other version there, in which he acquires by way of pulling. And if you ask: How could one have thought that [the case] is dealing with a purse? It is an item [acquired by] lifting! If so, how is he liable regarding Shabbat? Surely this is not a normal way of carrying out [an object], as the Gemara infers at the beginning of "Eilu Na'arot" (there): If [the objects were] small ones, this is not a normal way of carrying out; rather [it applies only] with medium-sized ones. And one can answer that there are things for which this is the normal way of carrying out with regard to Shabbat, and nevertheless, with regard to acquisition, [such items] are acquired only by lifting, since it is their way to be lifted. Alternatively, [the case] is where he was dragging [the items] out through a tunnel, which is a normal way of carrying out. Alternatively, [the Gemara] should have said, "And according to your own reasoning."

Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:9:1.hebrew: לצדדין קתני - תימה לרשב"א: אמאי לא מוקי לה בכלים שאין דרכן להגביה, שגם הן נקנין בהגבהה? כדמשמע לעיל דאוקמינן במידי דבעי מיתנא, וקתני "הגונב כיס בשבת חייב" — שכבר נתחייב בגניבה, דהיינו בהגבהה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86a:9:1.english: "It teaches it disjunctively" - The Rashba found this puzzling: Why does [the Gemara] not establish it [i.e., the baraita] with regard to vessels that are not normally lifted, since these too are acquired by lifting? As is implied above, where we established [the case] with an item that requires a rope, and [the baraita] teaches, "One who steals a purse on Shabbat is liable" — for he has already become liable for theft, that is, through lifting:
